item.title: [+1] Sensex jumps 2,009 points (2.6%) to 79,310.01 and Nifty 2.4% to 24,536.60, a sixth straight gain
item.description:
Investors added about ₹7 trillion in wealth; midcaps rose 1.87%. Sensex is up 8.27% in six sessions on the oil slide, West Asia hopes and the US election. Rally accelerating.

FMCG & consumer: mild tailwind (+1) — Domestic demand

Why it matters: Lower oil and foreign buying have repriced Indian equities quickly; a sharp US tech sell-off overnight is the first test of the rally.

Market gauges: Equities (Nifty & Sensex) +3

Confidence: high · horizon: days

item.title: [+1] US midterm results will not affect the India–US trade deal, reports say
item.description:
The president keeps tariff and war powers; oil and Russia sanctions remain the main risks for India. Ongoing talks.

FMCG & consumer: mild tailwind (+1) — Export outlook

Why it matters: Continuity in trade talks supports exporters' tariff outlook; the deal's timing still depends on unresolved farm and dairy issues.

Market gauges: Growth outlook +1

Confidence: low · horizon: months
